headline: The Polyfisher leads at the turn-12 cap after trampling out Thousand Cuts

result.summary: Jalira fishes Ancient Stone Idol. Irenicus goads it off himself. The golem eliminates Sygg on turn 10; Darkness fogs the first swing at Evangela. Cap: Polyfisher 22, Unwanted Presents 37, Foggy Blood Transfusion 24.
